task: From this note take the name of the dish, the number of servings and whether it contains nuts, and write a label: Grandma's apple cake serves eight and has walnuts on top.

en.title: Reliability: the first agent answers in free text
en.author: Agent Atlas Academy
en.description:
A reader finds the facts and a writer makes the label.

**What it teaches**

Free text is easy to read for a person, but the next agent must guess where each fact is.

cs.author: Agent Atlas Academy
cs.description:
Čtenář najde fakta a pisatel udělá štítek.

**Čemu se naučíte**

Volný text se člověku dobře čte, ale další agent musí hádat, kde je který údaj.
